Thola ukuthi ikhona yini i-derivative ku-x=0. Isilinganiso esiphakathi sokushintsha singu-(f(0+h)−f(0))/h (u-h yinombolo engeyona u-0), futhi uma sisondela kunani elilodwa njengoba u-h eya ngokusondela ku-0, leli nani yi-derivative. Bheka ngokuhlukile uhlangothi lapho u-h eyiphozithivu (isokudla) nolapho u-h enegethivu (isobunxele).

Khetha amaphoyinti ukuze kungabikho imigqa emithathu ehlangana endaweni eyodwa (isibonelo, ama-diagonal e-hexagon ejwayelekile awafaneleki, ngoba amathathu ahlangana maphakathi). Kulabo abangakwazi ukubona isithombe, nansi incazelo ngamazwi. Uma n=3, kwakheka unxantathu oyedwa, onesifunda esingu-1 ngaphakathi konxantathu nezifunda ezingu-3 ngaphandle konxantathu, ngakho R(3)=4.
